## Snopes

/snoʊps/ NOUN and sometimes VERB
We are the internet’s go-to source for discerning what is true and what is total nonsense. Before you scroll further, a few tips on how to “snopes”:

#### Search

Thousands upon thousands of fact checks and investigations live in our archives. You might want to bookmark this page.

#### Discover

Browse the most popular or most recent content when you visit the Top Posts and What’s New pages.

#### Submit

Can’t find what you’re looking for? Send us a note. Your tip could be our next assignment.

100/100

NewsGuard has given Snopes a perfect 100/100 credibility rating, a score given to only a handful of news outlets with the highest of editorial standards.

This badge signifies Snopes.com's compliance with the International Fact Checking Network's highest standards of combating misinformation online.
